$description: Rhythm and position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Each id must have an implementation in schema/semantic_validate.py (RULE_IMPLS); verify_all.py fails if the two sets diverge. Rules were checked against the real node sequences in templates/templates.json when written.

rules.description: At most one HERO-category section per page.
Pages should open with a HERO-category section.
rules.exceptionReason: Legal, docs and changelog templates are hero-less by design: they start with body content directly under the header (CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md section 7; CLONE_SPEC_DOCS.md 5.1: 'There is no page title or hero on the changelog index').

rules.description: shell.header must be the first node.
The footer is the last node whose slot is 'flow'; overlay nodes may follow it.
Adjacent flow sections should not share a category.
rules.exceptionReason: Measured real adjacencies: the four homepage feature shells, the stacked brandkit/join-us CONTENT cards, the legal header and body that are consecutive children of one article, and the docs/changelog shell parts (including the changelog entry header and body, which alternate on the index) are genuinely adjacent on the original.

rules.description: A section whose contract sets constraints.onePerPage appears at most once.
A section with constraints.maxPerPage (features.feature-shell: 4) may repeat only with distinct variants, keyed on (section, variant).

constraints.mustFollow: the immediately preceding node is the named section (mobile-menu after header; changelog.entry-body after changelog.entry-header; pagination after changelog.entry-body; content.legal-body after content.legal-header).
constraints.mustFollowNav: every node before it is slot 'chrome'.
constraints.mustPrecedeFooter: the section appears before the footer.
A section may only be used in the templates listed in constraints.allowedTemplates (route restriction; e.g. hero.home only on template.home, HubSpot-replica forms only on enterprise/team-plan).
PageSpec.route must belong to the declared template (exact list or regex).
At most 5 nodes per page may use a continuous pattern.

notApplicable.NO_CONSECUTIVE_SCROLL_STAGES: The original has no scroll-linked section motion (CLONE_SPEC.md section 12: 'No parallax, no marquee, no scroll-linked transforms'), and the motion enum has no scroll-stage pattern.

measuredFrom.quote: No parallax, no marquee, no scroll-linked transforms on page sections.
